title: Vaporesso Luxe XR Max 2 Pod Kit
description:
The
Vaporesso Luxe XR Max 2 Pod Kit
is a high-powered pod mod with a massive 3200mAh MEGA BATT battery, 80W output, GTX Dual Mesh coils, and a 0.96-inch TFT colour screen with dynamic RGB lighting. Features precise airflow adjustment from tight MTL to open DTL.
Product Type:
Pod Mod (Refillable, Replaceable Coils)
Battery:
3200mAh (MEGA BATT Technology)
Wattage:
5-80W (Variable Wattage)
Charging:
USB Type-C (2A)
E-Liquid Capacity:
5mL
Coil Type:
Replaceable - uses Vaporesso GTX Coils
Coil Resistance:
0.2Ω GTX Dual Mesh (DTL) + 0.8Ω GTX Mesh (MTL) included
Activation:
Button Fire
Airflow:
Adjustable Slider (MTL to DTL)
Display:
0.96" TFT Colour Screen + RGB Lighting
Chipset:
AXON (Pulse Mode)
Fill Method:
Bottom Fill
Pod Compatibility:
Vaporesso Luxe XR Pods (GTX Coils), Luxe X Pods (Integrated Coil)
Brand:
Vaporesso
E-liquid sold separately. Suitable for both salt nic (low wattage) and freebase (high wattage) e-liquids depending on coil choice.
Available options: Black, Blue.
